skill.summary: > 融合奥美/BBDO/盛世长城/扬罗必凯四大家 · 实战导向 · 每次写广告必用。触发词：skill, 优化, 品牌, brand。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the ad-creator (广告创意skill) version 1.0.0.
- Provides a comprehensive methodology for advertising creation, incorporating Ogilvy, BBDO, Saatchi & Saatchi, and Y&R approaches.
- Step-by-step practical guide: product DNA extraction, deep consumer insight, creative idea screening, structured copywriting (AIDA), compelling headlines, effective body text, and self-checklist.
- Includes creative toolkits and suggestions for adapting content to different ad channels.
- Offers clear, actionable processes and checklists for producing high-impact, differentiated brand advertising.
